confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no live booking pages, menus, or current listings were inspected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most reliable; July accommodation is least certain because beach-season demand in Haeundae and Seomyeon can move room rates a lot. Cocktail and wine anchors are set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge of Busan bar pricing is weaker. FX value comes from search-result summaries citing the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page, so verify the 2026-10-14 entry against the live RBA table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Basis is a regional judgment: East Asian mid-sized port and tourism cities, with Busan's restaurant and hotel levels placed below Seoul; accommodation reflects July demand in Haeundae and Seomyeon.
